test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who is the 16th Attorney General of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**R. Venkataramani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• Senior Advocate **R. Venkataramani** was appointed as the **16th Attorney General of India** by the **President of India** for a term of three years starting from **October 1, 2022**.

• He succeeded **K.K. Venugopal**, the **15th Attorney General**, whose tenure concluded on **September 30, 2022**, after he declined a further extension due to personal reasons.

• The **Attorney General of India** is the highest-ranking law officer in the country and serves as the primary legal advisor to the **Government of India**.

• Under **Article 76** of the **Indian Constitution**, the **President** appoints a person who is qualified to be a **Judge of the Supreme Court** to this prestigious position.

• **R. Venkataramani** has over 42 years of legal practice and has previously served as a member of the **Law Commission of India** in **2010** and **2013**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

• **K.K. Venugopal**:

• Served as the **15th Attorney General of India** from **July 2017** to **September 2022**.

• He is a recipient of the **Padma Vibhushan** and **Padma Bhushan** for his contributions to public affairs and law.

• **Mukul Rohatgi**:

• Served as the **14th Attorney General** from **2014 to 2017**.

• He is a veteran **Senior Advocate** known for representing various state governments and high-profile corporate entities in the **Supreme Court**.

• **Tushar Mehta**:

• Currently serves as the **Solicitor General of India**, the second-highest legal officer in the nation.

• The **Solicitor General** assists the **Attorney General** and is appointed by the **Appointments Committee of the Cabinet**.

• **Constitutional Provisions**:

• The **Attorney General** holds office during the **pleasure of the President** and receives remuneration as determined by the President.

• They have the **right of audience** in all courts across India and the right to participate in **Parliamentary proceedings** without the right to vote.
